notes: Qt 6.4.2; scene graph backend=default/RHI (graphicsApi enum 1); platform=xcb. frame_ms = interval between consecutive QQuickWindow::frameSwapped emissions (software: after QSGSoftwareRenderLoop rendered the dirty regions and flushed the QBackingStore to X (xcb/SHM); RHI/GL: after swapBuffers returned on the render thread); QT_QPA_UPDATE_IDLE_TIME=0 (Qt default 5 ms pacing of update requests removed unless --paced); redraw requested continuously (window->update() from a queued tick after every frameSwapped; no vsync/timer pacing). GridView of 600 Image{asynchronous:true,sourceSize 128x128} via QQuickImageProvider (decode+smooth downscale off UI thread, timed inside provider); zoom via item scale 1->3->1 / 6s; scroll ping-pong 3000px/s.
